Diffusion · Forward Noise &amp; Reverse.zh: 扩散 · 前向加噪与逆向去噪

A diffusion model learns to reverse a no.zh: 扩散模型学习如何逆转一个加噪过程。拖动时间步滑块——观察一个二维形状如何溶解为高斯噪声。按下“逆向”——观察噪声如何重新组装回该形状。所有现代图像生成器都沿用这一思想。
A diffusion model learns to reverse a no.src: A diffusion model learns to reverse a noising process. Drag the timestep slider — watch a 2D shape dissolve into Gaussian. Press "reverse" — watch noise reassemble back into the shape. Every modern image generator rides this idea.

@@T0@@~9 min@@T1@@@@T2@@Deep Learning ·.zh: @@T0@@约 9 分钟@@T1@@@@T2@@深度学习 · 扩散 · DDPM@@T3@@

The forward process is fixed: repeatedly.zh: 前向过程是固定的：反复加入少量高斯噪声，直至数据与 N(0, I) 无法区分。逆向过程则是学得的：神经网络预测每一步加入了多少噪声，从而可以把它减掉，一步步回溯。
The forward process is fixed: repeatedly.src: The forward process is fixed: repeatedly add small Gaussian noise until the data becomes indistinguishable from N(0, I). The reverse process is learned: a neural network predicts how much noise was added at each step, so you can subtract it and work your way back.

Because Gaussians compose under noise-ad.zh: 由于高斯分布在加噪下可复合，你可以直接从 x_0 采样出 x_t，而无需逐时间步推进——这带来巨大的训练加速。α̅_t 是噪声保留因子的累积乘积；它从 t=0 时的约 1 降至 t=T 时的约 0。
Because Gaussians compose under noise-ad.src: Because Gaussians compose under noise-addition, you can sample x_t directly from x_0 without stepping through — huge training speedup. α̅_t is a cumulative product of noise-retention factors; it goes from ~1 at t=0 to ~0 at t=T.

The training objective · DDPM loss.zh: 训练目标 · DDPM 损失

Sample a random clean image, a random ti.zh: 随机采样一个干净图像、一个随机时间步与一个随机噪声 ε。计算 x_t。要求网络预测 ε。这就是全部的损失。简单、稳定，而且比其余一切方案都更有效。
Sample a random clean image, a random ti.src: Sample a random clean image, a random timestep, and a random noise ε. Compute x_t. Ask the network to predict ε. That's the entire loss. Simple, stable, and works better than everything else.

The reverse process · where the magic li.zh: 逆向过程 · 奥秘所在
The reverse process · where the magic li.src: The reverse process · where the magic lives

That's why DDPM's loss is just "predict the noise" — once $\epsilon_\theta$ is good, the reverse mean is automatic.

DDIM · skip steps without quality loss.zh: DDIM · 在无质量损失的前提下跳步
DDIM · skip steps without quality loss.src: DDIM · skip steps without quality loss

Set $\Delta = T/N$; you get $N$-step sampling. Quality survives well even at $N = 25$. The successors (DPM-Solver, UniPC) push the floor below 10 steps.

Classifier-free guidance · the condition.zh: 无分类器引导 · 条件控制的杠杆

Compute the noise prediction with the co.zh: 分别计算带条件 $c$ 与@@T0@@不带@@T1@@条件（模型在训练时也见过的一个空 / “空条件”）的噪声预测。在条件预测之外按 $w$ 外推。$w$ 大 → 强烈贴合提示但多样性下降；$w \approx 7$ 是 Stable Diffusion 的默认值。@@T2@@CFG 尺度可视化器@@T3@@在一个二维玩具示例上展示了这一点。
Compute the noise prediction with the co.src: Compute the noise prediction with the condition $c$ and without (an empty / "null" condition the model also saw during training). Extrapolate beyond the conditional prediction by $w$. Large $w$ → strongly on-prompt but less diverse; $w \approx 7$ is the Stable-Diffusion default. The CFG scale visualiser shows this on a 2D toy.

What changed between DDPM (2020) and tod.src: What changed between DDPM (2020) and today

@@T0@@Latent diffusion (Stable Diffusion.zh: @@T0@@潜空间扩散（Stable Diffusion，2022）。@@T1@@ 在小型的 VAE 潜空间（64×64）中而非像素空间（512×512）中运行扩散。便宜 64 倍，质量相同。
@@T0@@Latent diffusion (Stable Diffusion.src: Latent diffusion (Stable Diffusion, 2022). Run the diffusion in a small VAE latent (64×64) instead of pixels (512×512). 64× cheaper, same quality.

@@T0@@Velocity / v-prediction.@@T1@@ Pre.zh: @@T0@@速度 / v-预测。@@T1@@ 直接预测 $v_t = \sqrt{\bar\alpha_t}\,\epsilon - \sqrt{1-\bar\alpha_t}\,x_0$，而非 $\epsilon$。数值行为更好，用于 Imagen、Stable Diffusion 3。
@@T0@@Velocity / v-prediction.@@T1@@ Pre.src: Velocity / v-prediction. Predict $v_t = \sqrt{\bar\alpha_t}\,\epsilon - \sqrt{1-\bar\alpha_t}\,x_0$ rather than $\epsilon$ directly. Better numerical behaviour, used in Imagen, Stable Diffusion 3.

@@T0@@Flow-matching / rectified flow.@@T.zh: @@T0@@流匹配 / 整流流。@@T1@@ 重新表述为一个常微分方程；训练以预测速度场。SD3、AuraFlow。理论更干净，推理更快。
@@T0@@Flow-matching / rectified flow.@@T.src: Flow-matching / rectified flow. Reformulate as an ODE; train to predict the velocity field. SD3, AuraFlow. Cleaner theory, faster inference.

@@T0@@Consistency models (2023).@@T1@@ D.src: Consistency models (2023). Distil a slow diffusion into a 1-step generator. Single-step sampling at usable quality.

@@T0@@Score-based view (Song &amp; Ermon.zh: @@T0@@基于分数的视角（Song 与 Ermon，2019）。@@T1@@ 同一模型可等价表述为分数 $\nabla_x \log p_t(x)$。SDE / ODE 的视角涵盖了 DDPM。
@@T0@@Score-based view (Song &amp; Ermon.src: Score-based view (Song & Ermon, 2019). Same model, equivalent formulation as score $\nabla_x \log p_t(x)$. The SDE / ODE perspective subsumes DDPM.

@@T0@@Conditioning via cross-attention.@.src: Conditioning via cross-attention. Stable Diffusion uses cross-attention into the UNet to attend to a CLIP-encoded prompt; see the U-Net article's diffusion section.

meta.tagline: 观察一个二维形状溶解为高斯噪声，再重新组装回自身
meta.summary: DDPM 在 T 个步骤中把数据污染为噪声，并学习逆转这一污染过程。拖动时间步滑块，观察一个二维分布（螺旋）溶解为各向同性高斯；再按下“逆向”，观察它重新组装。这就是 Stable Diffusion 背后的直觉，一步一步呈现。
highlights: 把时间步 t 从 0 滑到 1000；观察一个二维形状溶解为噪声。
噪声调度切换：线性 vs 余弦。
“逆向”按钮把去噪过程从纯噪声动画演示回原形状。
理解前向的闭式表达：x_t = √(α̅_t) x_0 + √(1−α̅_t) ε。
为何扩散战胜了 GAN：训练稳定、样本多样、似然强。
